title: share common Comm-B semantic views
change_description: The oracle scalar view reuses decoded table values and applies the original exact per-name adjustments, preserving unavailable fields and ordered layouts for every natural register and payload. The standard numeric view reuses the already constructed oracle expression list, retaining BDS30/BDS44 exceptions and BDS05/65 routing. These are pure scalar and expression-list equalities; Float evaluators and callbacks are unchanged. [Implementation and proof evidence](../docs/GEN24-SEMANTIC-SHARING.md).
row_note: Proved common Comm-B semantic-view sharing; full fixed/fresh 10M validation; clean fresh build; CPU 0; 3+21 ABAB
review_threshold: Both decode and CPR must independently reach 2/1; exact integer comparisons of measured medians; stop for user review only when both hold.
note: Prepared after completed fixed/fresh/native validation and before timing. Contains no speculative measurement. The unchanged reviewed reporting helper archives only completed measurements.

reporting_helper.cpr_overhead: Report both implementations: signed difference of independent CPR/decode mode medians divided by the unchanged corpus count; retain noise and clock limitations.

requirements.pre_timing: Full gate/fresh/native independent passes, clean source commit, all other jobs stopped, unchanged frozen ABAB interleaver in decode and CPR, fresh measured worker with all source/C/object/trace hashes, power-plan and monotonic/UTC evidence.

output_protocol.source_basename: gen24-<actual committed HEAD first 7 hex characters>
output_protocol.commit_resolution: Resolve only after the reviewed source commit and clean-tree verification. No guessed commit or worker hash.
output_protocol.no_retry_or_relocation: Construct the correct path before the single isolated run; preserve any failure and all original data.
